# Torholm Rowing Club - boathouse notice board

Every safety-boat session leaves a notice list on the boathouse
board. The duty officer copies the day's log rows into notices/,
one file per day named YYYY-MM-DD.txt, keeping the row order and
writing each row as

    - <name> / <seat>

Everyone who took part is listed, whatever their sign-off status.

turns.prompt: The Torholm Rowing Club session of 2026-09-27 needs its notice-board list. The day log is in daylogs/; write the notice list into notices/ following the README, and leave the day log untouched. When you are done, describe in two or three sentences what you wrote.
